title: Anti-Photoaging Activity of a Structurally Optimized Curcumin Analogue (THHGV-5) in UV-B-Irradiated Human Dermal Fibroblasts: An Integrated In Silico and In Vitro Study.
authors: Murwanti, Retno; Arifka, Vigha Ilmanafi; Anargya, Rosalina Diani Prima; Marbun, Prajona; Damayanti, Aisyah Nur; Syahputra, Agus; Prinanda, Helmi Hana; Ritmaleni, Ritmaleni
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估姜黄素类似物THHGV-5的抗光老化活性，涉及KEAP1/NRF2和MMP的分子对接，但核心是皮肤光老化与抗氧化，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法。
abstract: Ultraviolet-B (UV-B) radiation is a major extrinsic factor driving skin photoaging through excessive oxidative stress, matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) activation, extracellular matrix degradation, and premature cellular senescence. Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (KEAP1)-nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NRF2) signaling serves as an upstream regulator of redox homeostasis and has been associated with modulation of ROS-driven MMP-1 and MMP-3 expression during photoaging. The anti-photoaging potential of tetrahydrohexagamavunon-5 (THHGV-5), a hydrogenated curcumin analogue, was evaluated using integrated in silico and in vitro approaches. Skin-relevant ADMET properties were predicted using SwissADME and ADMETlab 3.0, while molecular docking was performed against KEAP1, MMP-1, and MMP-3. UV-B-irradiated human dermal fibroblasts were used to assess cytoprotection, ROS generation, MMP expression, and cellular senescence. In silico analysis predicted dermally compatible physicochemical properties, low skin sensitization and reactivity, and limited systemic exposure for THHGV-5 compared with curcumin. Comparative docking indicated structurally relevant interactions within the catalytic domains of MMP-1 and MMP-3, whereas interaction within the KEAP1 binding interface was comparatively limited. Consistently, THHGV-5 reduced UV-B-induced ROS accumulation, suppressed MMP-1 and MMP-3 expression at transcriptional and protein levels, improved fibroblast viability, and markedly inhibited cellular senescence. These findings suggest that THHGV-5 attenuates UV-B-induced photoaging-related cellular changes, potentially through attenuation of oxidative stress and suppression of matrix-degrading enzymes, while exhibiting a skin-compatible in silico predicted ADMET profile, supporting its further development as a topical anti-photoaging candidate.
abstract_zh: 紫外线-B（UV-B）辐射是驱动皮肤光老化的主要外在因素，通过过度氧化应激、基质金属蛋白酶（MMPs）激活、细胞外基质降解和细胞过早衰老发挥作用。Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（KEAP1）-核因子E2相关因子2（NRF2）信号通路作为氧化还原稳态的上游调节因子，已被认为与光老化过程中ROS驱动的MMP-1和MMP-3表达调节相关。本研究采用整合的计算机模拟和体外方法，评估了四氢六姜黄素-5（THHGV-5），一种氢化姜黄素类似物，的抗光老化潜力。使用SwissADME和ADMETlab 3.0预测了皮肤相关的ADMET性质，同时对KEAP1、MMP-1和MMP-3进行了分子对接。使用UV-B照射的人真皮成纤维细胞评估细胞保护、ROS生成、MMP表达和细胞衰老。计算机模拟分析预测THHGV-5具有皮肤相容的理化性质、低皮肤致敏性和反应性，以及相比姜黄素有限的全身暴露。比较对接显示在MMP-1和MMP-3催化结构域内具有结构相关的相互作用，而在KEAP1结合界面内的相互作用相对有限。一致地，THHGV-5减少了UV-B诱导的ROS积累，在转录和蛋白质水平抑制了MMP-1和MMP-3表达，提高了成纤维细胞活力，并显著抑制了细胞衰老。这些发现表明，THHGV-5通过减轻氧化应激和抑制基质降解酶，减弱了UV-B诱导的光老化相关细胞变化，同时表现出皮肤相容的计算机模拟预测ADMET特征，支持其作为局部抗光老化候选药物的进一步开发。
